messages:
Marta R.: Procurement at EuroFin asked for a compact EU-only dataflow diagram + subprocessor CSV and KMS options they can attach to the SOW. Need by Tue COB. Can the POC team take this?

Diego H.: I can produce a public-safe one-page PNG: EU LB -> inference pool (EU GPUs) -> ephemeral KV cache -> encrypted object store (EU). Will strip hostnames and internal IDs.

Priya S.: Telemetry note: metrics/aggregates processed in eu-west1 and eu-central1 by default; alerting forwards to AlertCorp EU endpoints. Default retention: metrics 30d, redacted traces 90d. I'll confirm vendor datacenter pages.

Ben C.: KMS options: Redwood-managed keys (eu-west1 default for POC), customer-managed keys (CMK) in EU KMS, enterprise HSM via partner/on-prem for production. Add that cross-region backups require explicit customer opt-in.

Marta R.: Also include support access as a subprocessor: support engineers have audited access to sanitized traces (no raw prompts). Explicit statement: Redwood does not use Customer Data to train models.

Diego H.: Deliverables I propose: 1) single-page EU-only diagram PNG 2) subprocessors.csv (name, purpose, eu-region(s), data types touched, compliance link, evidence link) 3) 1-page Q&A + legal blurb.

Priya S.: Example CSV rows I'll include: CloudHostEU, Hosting, eu-west1, compute+object, SOC2/ISO27001 URL; MetricsCoEU, Observability, eu-west1, aggregated metrics, retention 30d; AlertsEU, Alerting, eu-west*, alerts only.

Ben C.: KMS blurb ready. SE handoff note: CMK provisioning in EU requires 3 business days for POC; HSM requires enterprise onboarding.

LegalBot: Draft legal sentence: "For Customer accounts configured to EU processing, Redwood will store and process Customer Data within EU jurisdictions unless Customer expressly enables cross-region features. Redwood will not use Customer Data to train models. The subprocessor roster is maintained and updated with prior notice per contract."

Marta R.: Owners: Diego = diagram, Priya = CSV + evidence links, Ben = KMS paragraph + SE contact, LegalBot = final signoff. Deadline: Tue COB. Ping me for blockers. :thumbsup:
